newsitem.title: USA: Amoco, Shell Oil agree on Permian Basin deal.
newsitem.headline: Amoco, Shell Oil agree on Permian Basin deal.

text.p: Amoco Corp and Shell Oil Co, U.S.-based unit of Anglo-Dutch Royal Dutch/Shell, on Tuesday said they have reached definitive agreement to combine their oil and natural gas producing assets in the greater Permian Basin area of West Texas and Southeast New Mexico.
The companies said they formed Altura Energy Ltd, a partnership company that will begin operations on March 1 as the third largest U.S. independent oil producer.

Amoco will own 64 percent and Shell 36 percent of the venture, which in 1996 had pro forma gross daily production from 6,300 wells of about 170,000 barrels of oil and 220 million cubic feet of natural gas, the companies said.
